models_evaluated: multimodal stroke classification model (call transcripts + health records)

links.outcome: Stroke-class F1 of AI models versus EMCC operator baseline on same calls
links.effect: Multimodal model stroke F1 0.77 vs operator baseline 0.73 and transcript-only model; about 26 false alerts per 1,000 calls vs 36 for operators at assumed 1.2% prevalence.
links.quote: The multimodal classification model achieved a stroke-class F1-score of 0.77, exceeding that of both the transcript-only model and the operator baseline (0.73).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a speech recognition model on local emergency call audio to reduce word error rate
Combining call transcripts with structured health record data (multimodal fusion) versus transcript-only
Streaming real-time evaluation at 30, 60, and 90 seconds of call

screen.reason: Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study simulating real-time AI decision support using call transcripts and EHR data to identify stroke during emergency dispatch calls compared to human operator baseline.
